subject: prd/impl-review
statement: If a lens or internal remediation round emits schema-invalid findings, including a reason-less decline, then the system shall void that pass output, retry once within the same pass identity, then apply UB-9; never persist free-form fallback or count the retry as another assurance pass
intent: invalid pass or visible absent-pass terminal
fit_criterion: malformed-output fixtures retry once, persist zero invalid/free-form findings, preserve pass count/identity, and remain non-accepting on repeated failure
